nina_sales: Quick escalation for Equinox POC — they insist on HSM-backed KMS proof and want both Procurement + Legal to sign the orderform before sending live traffic tomorrow morning. Can we compress approvals? :sos:

jordan_legal: We can do a POC-specific addendum. Two fast options: 1) timeboxed SLA bump to 99.95 with capped credits (low friction), or 2) grant 99.99 but requires GC sign-off (slow). Recommend option 1 for speed.

marc_finance: Billing note: we accept PO to billing@redwood.com as alternate acceptance for POC. Net30 by default. If they want us to issue invoice same day, ask them to include PO# and cc ar@redwood.com. DocuSign works too — include `procurement_email` and `legal_email` fields.

lee_eng: Tech constraints: true HSM-backed keys require Private deployment. Hosted can meet HSM semantics only if customer supplies key material (customer-managed keys) — that adds ~24h to validate. Landing zone + SAML + CIDR prep for Private is ~48h min (infra ticket + eng pairing). KMS audit logs retention 90d is okay.

nina_sales: Proposed fast path to Equinox: sign 1-page POC addendum (SLA 99.95, credits cap 20% POC fees, explicit nonprecedential clause) + pick signature flow: (A) DocuSign dual-signer OR (B) send PO to billing@redwood.com. Ask them to confirm within 2 hours so demo can proceed.

jordan_legal: I'll draft the addendum now. I'll add orderform metadata to help routing, e.g. orderform_meta: signer_roles=[Procurement,Legal]; acceptance_methods=[DocuSign,PO-email]. Also add fallback: PO emailed to billing@redwood.com constitutes acceptance.

marc_finance: If they choose PO, we'll fast-track invoicing same day. If DocuSign, ensure signers mapped to role fields and we have explicit emails. For urgency, request single procurement contact + single legal contact.

lee_eng: Created infra ticket INF-9911 for landing zone prep; ETA 48h if they provide SAML metadata, target CIDR, and admin contact. If they opt for Hosted + customer-supplied key material, plan for +24h to validate key provisioning. Link: https://redwood-internal/infra/INF-9911

nina_sales: Great — next steps:
- jordan_legal: send POC addendum in 30m (SLA 99.95, credits cap 20%)
- marc_finance: send invoice/PO template to customer if they need it
- lee_eng: confirm HSM exhibit wording for hosted vs private
I'll ping Equinox and ask them to pick DocuSign or PO and to provide signer emails if DocuSign. Thanks team :pray:

infra-bot: Reminder: attach POC test plan and evaluation criteria to the orderform before sending. Checklist: https://confluence/redwood/poc-checklist
